name: The Merman
source:
"After the Sea Queen suddenly disappears, her son Ademi plans to go to the surface to rescue her. But fate has other plans when he encounters a human he rescued in the past..."

[From [url=https://puzzle-deluxe.itch.io/the-merman]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“海女王突然失踪后，她的儿子阿德米打算去海面营救她。但命运却另有安排，当他遇到了他过去救过的人类……”

[来自[url=https://puzzle-deluxe.itch.io/the-merman]itch.io[/url]]
